name: tanstack-ai

providers.openai-responses: createOpenaiChat(model, apiKey, { baseURL: WIRETRUTH_BASE_URL_OPENAI_RESPONSES }); POST /v1/responses (the default OpenAI text adapter). https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/adapters/openai#createopenaichat-model-apikey-config
providers.anthropic: createAnthropicChat(model, apiKey, { baseURL: WIRETRUTH_BASE_URL_ANTHROPIC }); SDK appends /v1/messages.
providers.gemini: createGeminiChat(model, apiKey, { baseURL: WIRETRUTH_BASE_URL_GEMINI }); SDK appends /v1beta/models/<model>:streamGenerateContent or :generateContent.
providers.ollama-openai: openaiCompatible({ name: 'ollama', baseURL: WIRETRUTH_BASE_URL_OLLAMA_OPENAI, apiKey, models: [model] })(model); Chat Completions is the documented default for Ollama /v1. https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/adapters/openai-compatible

finish.primary: RUN_FINISHED.metadata.tanstack.finishReason is the documented normalized finish field (despite its metadata location). Unknown strings map to other. The provider's own finish string isn't exposed, so finish.raw stays null; nothing is reconstructed from error codes or provider payloads.

text.primary: TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT.delta concatenated, including content before an error.

usage.primary: RUN_FINISHED/RUN_ERROR.usage: promptTokens, completionTokens, totalTokens, promptTokensDetails.cachedTokens, completionTokensDetails.reasoningTokens. In-process chat() restores TanStack TokenUsage after AG-UI normalization. No absent counts are synthesized.

tool_calls.primary: TOOL_CALL_START.toolCallId/toolCallName, TOOL_CALL_ARGS.toolCallId/delta, TOOL_CALL_END.toolCallId/metadata.tanstack.args. Final public argument strings are strictly JSON-decoded for comparison, without repair; unfinished calls retain unparsed deltas. Only toolDefinition metadata is supplied, with no server/execute implementation. TOOL_CALL_RESULT.metadata.tanstack.state=output-error exposes an error as data; content is retained as its message without parsing or repair. Tool failures do not override the run completion signal.

structured.primary: chat({ outputSchema }) returns the parsed value or throws. Plain JSON Schema is accepted; no Standard Schema runtime validator is added. No error-side rawText is promoted to primary.

stream.primary: part.type selects AG-UI events; RUN_FINISHED sets completed=true only if no RUN_ERROR preceded it. RUN_ERROR.message/code becomes a returned error (code used as the error type, or RUN_ERROR when absent). EOF alone leaves completion null; thrown errors set false. Error name/message/stack and prototype constructor names feed classifyError; no provider response internals are read.

error_map.message_regex: maximum token limit was reached|response was incomplete.*max_output_tokens

Both claude-haiku-4-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5 get native structured output (output_config.format), so no supported path sends the fixture's forced structured_output tool call.
On these models chat({ outputSchema }) requests a streamed response, even without tools, so it never sends the non-streamed request this fixture replays.

config_notes: All SDK retries and the default agent-loop strategy are retained. Tools have no execute/server implementation, so valid calls wait for external results. Malformed tool JSON can still trigger the default recovery loop. debug=false silences the default error logger, whose console.dir metadata would corrupt the stdout protocol. https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/advanced/debug-logging https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/api/ai

Only scenario token limits change modelOptions: OpenAI Chat max_tokens; Responses max_output_tokens; compatible max_tokens; Anthropic max_tokens; Gemini maxOutputTokens; native Ollama options.num_predict. Stop sequences aren't mapped: every stop fixture is non-streamed and unsupported. https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/api/ai#chat-options

System messages become systemPrompts; other messages retain their order and roles. reasoning.effort=none maps to the documented off level; other levels pass through. Null leaves the default alone. Adapters clamp levels to each model catalog; off can become minimal for Gemini 3 models. https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/adapters/gemini#reasoning

The Chat Completions and compatible adapters always send stream_options.include_usage=true, so the include_usage hint needs no option. Other stream usage defaults are retained. https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/adapters/openai#model-options
There is no documented eager_input_streaming option in the Anthropic adapter; that hint is left to provider defaults. https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/adapters/anthropic

In these pins, chat({ outputSchema }) selects streaming combined schema output on OpenAI Chat (response_format.json_schema), Responses (text.format.json_schema), Anthropic Haiku 4.5 and Sonnet 5.5 (output_config.format), Gemini 3.x (generationConfig.responseSchema/responseMimeType), and compatible Chat (response_format.json_schema). Native Ollama skips the text phase with no tools, invokes structuredOutput once, and sends stream=false with format=<schema>. The non-streamed schema fixtures for the streaming paths are unsupported. https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/api/ai#usage-examples

Anthropic includes both claude-haiku-4-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5 in ANTHROPIC_COMBINED_TOOLS_AND_SCHEMA_MODELS and ANTHROPIC_NO_FORCED_TOOL_MODELS. Neither uses the legacy forced structured_output tool path. https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/adapters/anthropic

finish.unknown-value has only non-streamed fixtures and is unsupported. On streams, unfamiliar Chat/compatible finish strings pass through; Responses maps unrecognized incomplete reasons to stop; Anthropic maps unrecognized nonempty stop_reason to stop; Gemini maps any non-MAX_TOKENS finish to stop (or tool_calls); native Ollama ignores done_reason and chooses stop/tool_calls. No shim correction is applied.
